about.title: About Universal Unit Converter
about.description: The Universal Unit Converter is a comprehensive all-in-one measurement tool that handles conversions across all major unit categories including length, weight, temperature, volume, area, speed, energy, pressure, power, and data storage. This professional-grade converter supports metric, imperial, and specialized units with precision calculations for engineering, scientific, and everyday applications.

faq.q: What unit categories does the universal converter support?
faq.a: Our universal unit converter supports length, weight/mass, temperature, volume, area, speed/velocity, energy, pressure, power, and data storage units. Each category includes metric, imperial, and specialized scientific units for comprehensive coverage.

faq.q: How accurate are the conversion calculations?
faq.a: The universal unit converter provides high-precision calculations with up to 15 decimal places accuracy. All conversion factors are based on internationally recognized standards and are regularly updated for maximum precision.

faq.q: Can I convert between different unit categories?
faq.a: No, conversions are only possible within the same unit category (e.g., length to length, weight to weight). Different categories measure different physical quantities and cannot be directly converted without additional context.

faq.q: Does the converter work with scientific notation?
faq.a: Yes, the universal unit converter accepts and displays results in scientific notation for very large or very small numbers, making it suitable for scientific and engineering applications.

faq.q: Are imperial and metric units both supported?
faq.a: Absolutely! The converter includes comprehensive support for both metric (SI) and imperial (US/UK) measurement systems, plus specialized units used in various industries and scientific fields.

faq.q: Can I use this for professional engineering work?
faq.a: Yes, the universal unit converter meets professional standards with precise calculations, extensive unit coverage, and scientific notation support suitable for engineering, research, and technical applications.
